profile.headline: Software Engineer at Contentful
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer who is driven by creative problem solving, continuous learning, and teamwork. I enjoy building applications that improve workflows and create efficiencies for the end user.

Front End Experience: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, HTML, CSS, Jest, Storybook
Salesforce Development Experience: 4x Salesforce Certified (JavaScript Developer I, Platform Developer I, Platform App Builder, Administrator), Apex, SOQL, Visualforce, Lightning Component Framework

My 10 years of experience working in higher education administration have given me a strong foundation in communication, collaboration, relationship building, project management, and people development. I thrive working in team-oriented organizations that value the diverse perspectives of their employees. As a former career services professional, I am passionate about helping people in their career journeys and transitions. Outside of work, I enjoy hiking, skiing, cycling, tennis, scuba diving, curling, and cooking.

Clifton StrengthsFinder Top Five Strengths: Discipline | Maximizer | Learner | Achiever | Responsibility

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Member of the newly formed US-based Integrations Team within the Ecosystem Product Line. Building tools, frameworks, community apps, and integrations that developers use to build with and extend the Contentful platform.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
TaskRay is a collaborative work management solution native to Salesforce and designed for post-sale processes such as onboarding, installations, and implementations. I worked as part of an agile team delivering new features, enhancements, and bug fixes for our product releases. Technologies used: React, JavaScript, TypeScript, Apex, Lightning Web Components

Accomplishments:
• Led the coordination and planning for an engineering initiative where we documented technical debt and developed a process for addressing these backlog items in sprints and product releases
• Took the initiative to lead some of our agile ceremonies, such as the coordination of our sprint demos
• Advocated for increased usage and adoption of Storybook to aid us in our front end development process
• Member of the company’s DEI Team and led initiatives aimed at creating a more inclusive culture

positions.title: Associate Director, Employer Engagement
positions.description:
• Developed the strategy and goals for employer relations for Boston College, managing a team of four full-time staff to increase the overall number of employers and opportunities available to BC students
• Oversaw all annual career fairs, with over 3,000 students attending, 300 employers, and bringing in over $100,000 in revenue for the Career Center 
• Led the implementation of a new campus-wide alumni-student mentoring platform with the Alumni Association; gaining thousands of student and alumni users within the first three months
• Served as a member of the Career Center leadership team where we developed a 5-year plan for the career center, implementing changes such as: organizational restructure to an industry-based model, focus on diversity, equity, and inclusion practices, and moving to a career coaching model

positions.title: Director, Alumni Engagement
positions.description:
• Developed and implemented a new Alumni Engagement department structure and managed a team of four full-time staff responsible for CAA's major engagement programs:
• Alumni Chapters: Engaged over 25,000 alumni through 80 regional, cultural, and special interest chapters
• The Berkeley Network: Provided strategic leadership for this alumni career services program, overseeing relationships with the UC Berkeley Career Center, volunteer leaders for corporate alumni networks, a webinar series, and in-person networking events
• YES Berkeley! Student Recruitment Program: In coordination with the Office of Undergraduate Admissions, engaged over 1,000 alumni in college fairs, yield receptions, and summer send-off parties
• Alumni Events: Developed budget and strategy for large-scale alumni engagement events

positions.title: Associate Director, Alumni Chapters and Student Recruitment
Assistant Director & Career Development Counselor, NYU Wasserman Center for Career Development
positions.description:
• Advised NYU School of Professional Studies students and alumni on various career development topics in one-on-one career coaching appointments, in-person seminars, and webinars.
• Developed a process for live-streaming our career seminars in order to better serve our non-traditional, online, and commuter students
• Built relationships with employers from a variety of industries, and liaised with student clubs and faculty
• Managed the Graduate Student Advisory Board and planned career conferences like the Non-Profit Boot Camp, attracting over 100 students and 25 employer attendees

positions.title: Graduate Assistant, Office of Global Programs
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Created 13 cultural orientation videos for students to view before they spent a semester studying abroad. Collaborated with global staff at NYU study abroad sites to create content for the videos, coordinated with the Digital Media Studio to record the webinars using Camtasia, wrote scripts, and created Prezis for each video. 
• Assisted with the visa and orientation process for approximately 20 incoming international exchange students each semester. Managed email communications to students and information on the international exchange website. Attended the in-person academic orientation for students and planned a farewell event at the end of the semester.

positions.title: Assistant Dean of Admission
positions.description:
• Managed recruitment activities in six domestic markets, traveling to these regions to build relationships with high school guidance counselors, community-based organizations, students, and parents
• Led large group information sessions and conducted informational interviews with prospective students and reviewed up to 1,200 applications and presented files during admissions committee
• Involved in marketing and communications projects, working with external vendors, participating in the university-wide website redesign committee, and managing content updates on the admissions website
• Co-led the admissions senior intern program, where we hired, trained, and supervised ten seniors each year
• Managed relationships with alumni volunteers to coordinate 25 receptions across the country for admitted students

positions.title: Sales & Marketing Associate/CRM Specialist
positions.description:
• Served as lead CRM administrator for Salesforce.com, overseeing the data migration and implementation to SFDC from previous CRM platform
• Created weekly sales pipeline and forecasting reports and dashboards for senior management and conducted enablement initiatives, including facilitating training sessions and creating instructional documentation for sales representatives
• Supported the sales team by attending industry trade shows and consistently surpassed quarterly goals for the number of meetings and calls scheduled with potential advertising clients

volunteerExperiences.description: Climb Hire prepares working adults for entry-level jobs in tech. I support Climbers in the Salesforce Admin track by attending volunteer nights where I provide resume reviews, LinkedIn profile reviews, and mock interviews.
Represent Colgate at college fairs and conduct informational interviews with prospective students. Attend congratulatory and send-off receptions for admitted and incoming students.

organizations.name: Toastmasters
organizations.description:
Member of the Boston College Toastmasters Club. Attended meetings, gave speeches, participated in table topics, took on meeting roles including reviewer and timekeeper.
https://bctoastmasters.toastmastersclubs.org/
